services.name: Adult Lessons
services.desc: The Family Fitness Center offers classes for infants ages six months to two years with one or both parents in the water. This class is perfect for little fish swimming for the first time without mom or dad! The emphasis is on having fun, getting comfortable in the water, blowing bubbles, supported front/back floats and playing water games. This class helps students to feel comfortable in the water and to enjoy the water safely. This class teaches safe water entry/exit, placing whole face in water, blowing bubbles through mouth/nose, floating on front/back with help, arm action on front/back with help. This class is designed to give students success with fundamental skills. This class
